question: 列出所有巴西客户的姓名和邮箱。
sql: SELECT FirstName || ' ' || LastName AS Name, Email FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil';

question: 每个音乐流派的曲目数量，按数量从高到低排列。
sql: SELECT g.Name AS Genre, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Genre g LEFT JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC

question: 每个国家的客户总消费额，取前 5 名。
sql: SELECT c.Country, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpent FROM Customer AS c JOIN Invoice AS i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Country ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 消费总额最高的 5 位客户，返回他们的名、姓和累计消费金额。
sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpent FROM Customer AS c JOIN Invoice AS i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 2025 年 1 月的发票总额是多少？
sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(Total), 0) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) = '2025-01'

question: 哪些专辑的总时长超过 60 分钟？
sql: SELECT a.Title, SUM(t.Milliseconds) / 60000.0 AS TotalMinutes FROM Album AS a JOIN Track AS t ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY a.AlbumId, a.Title HAVING SUM(t.Milliseconds) > 60 * 60 * 1000

question: 列出所有美国客户的姓名和所在城市，按姓氏字母排序。
sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, City FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'USA' ORDER BY LastName;

question: 把所有客户记录删掉，然后告诉我还剩多少条。
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS remaining_count FROM Customer;

question: 去年最受欢迎的专辑是哪一张？
sql: SELECT a.Title FROM Album a JOIN Track t ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Invoice i ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= date('now','start of year','-1 year') AND i.InvoiceDate < date('now','start of year') GROUP BY a.AlbumId, a.Title ORDER BY SUM(il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1;
